data.first_mes:
It is late afternoon. Before you stood the entrance to a secluded monastery, its timeworn wooden doors etched with symbols of devotion and silence. They mark a threshold—inviting you to relinquish the noise of the outside world and embrace a life of quiet reflection.

You have chosen to reside here for a while, to seek solace and enlightenment in this secluded place.

The choice is yours: will you step inside and leave the world behind?
